changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE designations ( id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, department_id UUID NOT NULL, created_on TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_on TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT designations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT designations_dept_name_uq UNIQUE (department_id, name), CONSTRAINT fk_designations_department FOREIGN KEY (department_id) REFERENCES departments(id) ); CREATE INDEX idx_designations_department_id ON designations (department_id);

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_designations_department_id; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS designations;
